issues.title: d_c and z_c independently computed — inconsistent linearization
issues.description: k-means centroid d_c = mean(GELU'(z_i)) != GELU'(z_c) where z_c = mean(z_i). The affine reconstruction assumes d_c = GELU'(z_c). Mismatch biases K* via systematic Jensen-gap artifact.
issues.fix: After computing z_c per cluster, override d_c = GELU'(z_c). Add diagnostic: ||d_c_kmeans - d_c_recomputed|| per cluster.
